seats.notes: …Pitchburn Devils, Traitorous Blood and Curse of the Pierced Heart. It runs Rebuke, Smite, Bonds of Faith, Rally the Peasants, Divine Reckoning, Gavony Township and three fliers or flier-makers, and cuts Dead Weight, Vampiric Fury, Riot Devils, Desperate Ravings and the black and green cards.

Blue is the deep colour, so I'm building mono-blue with colourless filler: Claustrophobia, Lost in the Mist, Stitched Drake, Manor Gargoyle and Geistcatcher's Rig carry the removal and threats. Nephalia Drownyard plus 16 Islands makes 17 lands, and I cut the red, green, white and black cards.

Blue-green self-mill: fuel Stitched Drake, Spider Spawning, Boneyard Wurm and Skaab with Forbidden Alchemy, Dream Twist and Mulch, backed by fliers and Prey Upon. Cut the white and red cards and the weakest green fillers; 17 lands with the Harbor and Drownyard.

Black-red aggro-midrange: cheap evasive creatures (Interlopers, Bat, Noble), removal (Volleys, Pyre, Lunge), and solid bodies (Fensnake, Patrol, Banshee). Cut Chant and the weaker black/red cards for Night Terrors and Horde to reach 23 spells with 17 lands.

…two Ghostly Possession as flier and threat answers, Creeping Renaissance for late value, and Naturalize for opposing auras. Cut Geistcatcher's Rig, Bramblecrush, Spare from Evil and Moonmist to keep the curve low; 9 Plains and 8 Forest match the white-heavy pips with Avacyn's Pilgrim adding white.

Black-red aggro-midrange: 23 spells weighted to black removal and cheap creatures, with red for Pitchburn Devils, Crossway Vampire, and Harvest Pyre. Cut the weak equipment, Bitterheart Witch, and the extra Village Ironsmith; 17 lands including Woodland Cemetery and Sulfur Falls.

Green-white creature deck with fliers, Slayer of the Wicked, Blazing Torch, and Feeling of Dread/Spidery Grasp as tricks and answers, plus Travel Preparations for its flashback. Cut the blue, black, and Cackling Counterpart, and kept 23 spells with 9 Forest and 8 Plains.

…blue creatures and mill-enabled Skaabs, plus Galvanic Juggernaut, removal (Geistflame, Frightful Delusion, Traitorous Blood, Rolling Temblor), and card selection. Cut the weak auras, white and black cards, Bloodcrazed Neonate, Wooden Stake, and Hysterical Blindness; run 9 Island and 8 Mountain.
